description: This file contains shell script functions for network interface configuration in an OpenWrt environment, including functions for finding network configurations, handling ubus calls, fixing interface parameters, scanning, preparing, and setting up network interfaces, as well as executing system controls.

methods.name: find_config
methods.description: Finds the network interface configuration associated with a given device.

methods.name: unbridge
methods.description: Stub function for unbridging interfaces; currently does nothing.

methods.name: ubus_call
methods.description: Performs a ubus call and processes JSON response.

methods.name: fixup_interface
methods.description: Adjusts interface configuration settings based on current status.

methods.name: scan_interfaces
methods.description: Loads network configuration and applies fixup to all interfaces.

methods.name: prepare_interface_bridge
methods.description: Prepares a network interface as a bridge.

methods.name: setup_interface
methods.description: Associates a device with a network interface configuration.

methods.name: do_sysctl
methods.description: Executes sysctl commands to set or get kernel parameters.
